name: semi-design
description: Semi Design System rules, lint hook, docs MCP server (semi_search, semi_docs, semi_example, semi_block, semi_brand) and /semi-ui, /semi-init, /semi-audit, /semi-fix, /semi-update, /semi-style, /semi-brand, /semi-propose, /semi-triage skills for Next.js 16 + React 19 + Tailwind 4 web projects.
suggestedPrompts: Run /semi-ui to build a page or component from Semi components and blocks
Run /semi-init to create a new app on the Semi Design System
Run /semi-audit to check this app against the Semi Design System (first step for an existing app)
Run /semi-fix to fix the issues the last /semi-audit found
Run /semi-update to upgrade @semi/ui and apply its release migrations
Run /semi-style to switch this app to another Semi style (Flat, Soft, Sharp)
Run /semi-brand to create a brand kit (colours, fonts, logo, voice, styles) that every product of the brand uses
Run /semi-propose to analyze project gaps and submit a feature request to Semi Design System
Run /semi-triage to evaluate and generalize incoming ecosystem issues
